Real DataForSEO responses, recorded on 2026-11-28 with generic queries only (US/English "running shoes", Saudi/Arabic "أحذية رياضية",
target wikipedia.org), trimmed to 10 result items and redacted (no login, balance, ids, timestamps, IPs, e-mails or paging cursors).
Used by the *-recorded tests instead of hand-written stand-ins.
`user-data.json` here is the account response cut down to its envelope and its top-level structure (timezone, rates, money, price, the subscription dates), all values redacted and with no balance, login or id; nested limit and statistics tables are emptied. Google redirect links (`google.com/goto?url=...`) in the SERP files have their opaque token replaced by `REDACTED`.
